arxiv-2109-11110.title: Pseudo-Hermitian Dirac operator on the torus for massless fermions under the action of external fields Journal: International Journal of Modern Physics A
arxiv-2109-11110.creator: Ö. Yeşiltaş, J. Furtado
arxiv-2109-11110.description: Abstract The Dirac equation in ( 2 + 1 ) (2+1) dimensions on the toroidal surface is studied for a massless fermion particle under the action of external fields. Using the covariant approach based in general relativity, the Dirac operator stemming from a metric related to the strain tensor is discussed within the Pseudo-Hermitian operator theory.

arxiv-2110-05672.title: Data-Driven Strictly Positive Real System Identification with prior System Knowledge
arxiv-2110-05672.creator: Nikhil Potu Surya Prakash Zhi Chen, Roberto Horowitz
arxiv-2110-05672.description: Abstract Strictly Positive Real (SPR) transfer functions arise in many areas of engineering like passivity theory in circuit analysis and adaptive control to name a few. In many physical systems, it is possible to conclude that the system is Positive Real (PR) or SPR but system identification algorithms might produce estimates which are not SPR.

arxiv-2201-07499.title: Multi-link Operation in IEEE 802.11be WLANs

arxiv-2201-07499.description: Abstract The multi-link operation (MLO) is a new feature proposed to be part of the IEEE 802.11be Extremely High Throughput (EHT) amendment. Such feature represents a paradigm shift towards multi-link communications, as nodes will be allowed to transmit and receive data over multiple radio interfaces concurrently. To make it possible, the 802.

arxiv-2309-11581.title: Self-Sustaining Oscillator with Frequency Counter for Resonance Frequency Tracking in Micro- and Nanomechanical Sensing
arxiv-2309-11581.creator: Hajrudin Bešić, Alper Demir, Veljko Vukićević, Johannes Steurer, Silvan Schmid
arxiv-2309-11581.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hajrudin Bešić, Alper Demir, Veljko Vukićević, Johannes Steurer, Silvan Schmid. Nanomechanical sensors based on detecting and tracking resonance frequency shifts are to be used in many applications. Various open- and closed-loop tracking schemes, all offering a trade-off between speed and precision, have been studied both theoretically and experimentally. In this work, we advocate the use of a frequency counter as a frequency shift monitor in conjunction with a self-sustaining oscillator (SSO) nanoelectromechanical system (NEMS) configuration.

arxiv-2403-18147.title: Divide, Conquer, Combine Bayesian Decision Tree Sampling
arxiv-2403-18147.creator: Jodie A. Cochrane, Adrian Wills, Sarah J. Johnson
arxiv-2403-18147.description: Abstract Decision trees are commonly used predictive models due to their flexibility and interpretability. This paper is directed at quantifying the uncertainty of decision tree predictions by employing a Bayesian inference approach. This is challenging because these approaches need to explore both the tree structure space and the space of decision parameters associated with each tree structure.

arxiv-2503-12953.title: Frame-wise Conditioning Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Diffusion Models in Text-to-Video Prediction
arxiv-2503-12953.creator: Zheyuan Liu zheyuan.liu@adelaide.edu.au, Junyan Wang junyan.wang@adelaide.edu.au, Zicheng Duan zicheng.duan@adelaide.edu.au, Cristian Rodriguez-Opazo cristian.rodriguezopazo@adelaide.edu.au, Anton van den Hengel anton.vandenhengel@adelaide.edu.au
arxiv-2503-12953.description: Abstract Text-video prediction (TVP) is a downstream video generation task that requires a model to produce subsequent video frames given a series of initial video frames and text describing the required motion. In practice TVP methods focus on a particular category of videos depicting manipulations of objects carried out by human beings or robot arms.

plos-pone-0007108.title: Economic Analysis of Pandemic Influenza Vaccination Strategies in Singapore
plos-pone-0007108.creator: Vernon J. Lee, Mei Yin Tok, Vincent T. Chow et al.
plos-pone-0007108.description: PLOS ONE research article. All influenza pandemic plans advocate pandemic vaccination. However, few studies have evaluated the cost-effectiveness of different vaccination strategies. This paper compares the economic outcomes of vaccination compared with treatment with antiviral agents alone, in Singapore.

pmc-10603498.title: Eligibility for Human Leukocyte Antigen–Based Therapeutics by Race and Ethnicity
pmc-10603498.creator: Timothée Olivier, Alyson Haslam, Jordan Tuia, Vinay Prasad
pmc-10603498.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). pmc-10702850.title: Prevalence and predicting factors for commonly neglected sexual side effects to brachytherapy for prostate cancer: a cross-sectional observational study
pmc-10702850.creator: Sami Beji, Alexander Bjørneboe Nolsøe, Christian Fuglesang S Jensen, Peter Busch Østergren, Jens Sønksen, Rasmus Bisbjerg, Henrik Jakobsen, Mikkel Fode
pmc-10702850.description: BackgroundLow-dose-rate brachytherapy (LDR-B) is an established treatment for localized prostate cancer. However, while erectile function is relatively well documented, other changes in sexual function are sparsely investigated.AimThe study sought to investigate orgasmic dysfunction, urinary incontinence during sexual activity (UIS), changes in penile morphology, and sensory disturbances in the penis following LDR-B.

pmc-11573479.title: TERT mutations and aggressive histopathologic characteristics of radioiodine-refractory papillary thyroid cancer
pmc-11573479.creator: Ju Yeon Pyo, Yoon Jin Cha, SoonWon Hong
pmc-11573479.description: BackgroundRadioiodine (RI) ablation following thyroid-stimulating hormone suppression is an effective treatment for papillary thyroid cancer (PTC), typically leading to favorable outcomes. However, RI-refractory tumors exhibit aggressive behavior and poor prognoses. Recent studies highlight the role of genetic abnormalities in PTC signaling pathways, including the activation of telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT), and the correlation of mutations with adverse outcomes.

pmc-11862319.title: Current situation regarding psychedelics and magic mushroom in Korea
pmc-11862319.creator: J S Seo
pmc-11862319.description: IntroductionRecently, the pros and cons have been debating in Korea even before the approval of use of medical marijuana with very strict limitations. And the next controversial topic is psychedelics. In 1890, when mescaline was first isolated from peyote cactus, clinical researches began, but due to its harmful effects, it was thereafter legally prohibited in 1970 in USA.

pmc-12374343.title: Design and development of a speech recognition test: a study of typically-developing Persian-speaking children
pmc-12374343.creator: Hoogol Nozari, Sima Tajik, Akram Ahmadi, Michelle Pascoe, Fereshteh Bagheri
pmc-12374343.description: BackgroundWe designed and validated a speech recognition test for Persian-speaking children aged 36–71 months.MethodsThis project was a cross-sectional and methodological study. Different steps of test development, encompassing item generation, content validity, construct validity, and reliability, were used to develop the scale.ResultsThe percentages of agreement among the experts’ answers concerning test characteristics were all greater than 88%.

pmc-12565044.title: Preoxygenation in the ICU
pmc-12565044.creator: Clément Monet, Mathieu Capdevila, Inès Lakbar, Yassir Aarab, Joris Pensier, Audrey De Jong, Samir Jaber, Epaminondas G Zakynthinos
pmc-12565044.description: Tracheal intubation is a frequent and high-risk procedure in the intensive care unit (ICU). Unlike elective intubation in the operating room, ICU intubation is often performed under emergent conditions in physiologically unstable patients, leading to increased technical difficulty and higher complication rates. Among these, hypoxemia is particularly frequent and represents a major determinant of morbidity and mortality.

pmc-12609542.title: Evaluating the Adjuvant Therapeutic Effects of Probiotic Strains Lactococcus cremoris and Lacticaseibacillus paracasei on Canine Atopic Dermatitis and Their Impact on the Gut and Skin Microbiome
pmc-12609542.creator: Hsiao-Wen Huang, Ting-Chen Yeh, Jui-Chun Hsieh, Ching-Wen Tsai, Ya-Jane Lee, Ming-Ju Chen, Demin Cai, Haoyu Liu, Ping Hu
pmc-12609542.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryAtopic dermatitis is a common and distressing skin disease in dogs, often causing itching, discomfort, and reduced quality of life. Current treatments can help but are not always sufficient, and long-term use of medications may have side effects. This study explored whether a special combination of two beneficial probiotics, used as a daily supplement, could support dogs with this condition. Eight dogs with atopic dermatitis were given the probiotic blend for 60 days.

pmc-12618580.title: Deficiency of Shank3 in the nucleus accumbens reveals a loss of social-specific motivation
pmc-12618580.creator: Oakleigh M Folkes, Meaghan Donahue, Sung Eun Wang, Paola N Negrón-Moreno, Nicole Xinyen Oo, Sheng-nan Qiao, Xiaoming Wang, Yong-hui Jiang
pmc-12618580.description: Social behavior deficits are a hallmark of autism and other neuropsychiatric disorders. SHANK3, a common causal gene for autism, is highly expressed in the nucleus accumbens (NAc), a critical brain region for social behaviors. We previously characterized conventional Shank3Δe4-22 deletion mice with increased unilateral social investigation and hypoactive NAc circuits.

pmc-12859831.title: MRI-based evaluation for predicting pathological response and monitoring reactive angioma evolution in triple-negative breast cancer undergoing neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy
pmc-12859831.creator: Luyi Lin, Jinlong Zheng, Fan Yang, Ke Zuo, Jiayin Zhou, Guanhua Su, Xiaowen Ma, Chao You, Yajia Gu
pmc-12859831.description: BackgroundNeoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with anti-programmed cell death protein-1 (PD-1) immunomodulators (NACI) has been proven to improve outcomes in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). However, the role of MRI in predicting therapeutic response remains underexplored. This study aims to investigate the utility of MRI for early response prediction and longitudinal assessment of reactive angiomatous changes in TNBC patients undergoing NACI therapy.

pmc-12989684.title: ScRNA-Seq Deciphers an Autocrine EFNA1-EPHA1 Loop That Reprograms the Microenvironment in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-12989684.creator: Yuanhong Chen, Yulian Tang, Yufan Ning, Yang Yang, Rensheng Tian, Yongjiao Mao, Zhiquan Feng, Wenxian Lin, Decai Wang, Xueping Feng
pmc-12989684.description: BackgroundHepatocytes demonstrate significant heterogeneity between normal liver tissue and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), with malignant hepatocytes playing a crucial role in remodeling the tumor microenvironment through specific ligand-receptor interactions. However, the mechanisms by which hepatocytes drive HCC progression at the single-cell level remain poorly understood.

pmc-13656507.title: Regulatory T cell levels in migraine: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13656507.creator: Emily Stuchfield-Denby, Samuel Adelou, Xavier Moisset, Radhouane Dallel
pmc-13656507.description: BackgroundAlthough recent research suggests that regulatory T (Treg) cells may be involved in migraine pathophysiology, no review has provided a comprehensive assessment of their levels in this condition. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to assess Treg levels in migraine patients.
